$comment: Source: CMHC 2834 NHA MBS Information Circular, extended English version (cmhc-2834-i-v2-extended-en.pdf). Field semantics were confirmed against filled CMHC circulars.
title: CMHC 2834 – NHA MBS Information Circular (Extended) – Form Values
description: JSON Schema for the values entered on the CMHC 2834 NHA MBS Information Circular (extended version, English, form footer 'CMHC 2834 1/09/2022'). The schema is normalized rather than a one-to-one copy of the XFA field tree: dates are ISO 8601 calendar dates, monetary amounts are numbers in Canadian dollars, percentages/rates are numbers (not strings with '%'), and values that the printed form repeats in page headers are not duplicated. The form's XFA data model contains many duplicate and anonymous field names; this schema gives each logical value a stable, descriptive property name. Unless stated otherwise, a value that is blank on the printed form is represented by an empty string (text), 0 (number), or an omitted optional property.

formVersion.description: Version/footer text printed on the form, for example 'CMHC 2834 1/09/2022'. Kept as a string so that older or newer revisions can also be represented.

language.description: Language of the circular. The extended form contains both an English and a French version; this schema describes the values shared by both.

wacRateType.description: Only for WAC pools (pool type 987): the 'Composition of Mortgage Loan Pool' radio selection in the WAC section of page 1 (labelled 'Adjustable' or 'Variable').

rateType.description: Rate type selected at the top of page 1: Fixed Rate, Variable Rate, Adjustable Rate, or WAC (weighted average coupon). XFA: Page1.Sub1.RadioButtonList (values 1–4).

poolType.description: Three-digit NHA MBS pool type selected in the 'Pool Type' list on page 1. The list is filtered by rate type. Labels: 867 Collateral Mortgage Pool; 880 Collateral Mortgage Pool; 881 Collateral Mortgage Pool - CORRA; 885 Collateral Mortgage Pool; 886 Collateral Mortgage Pool - CORRA; 964 Homeowner Loan Pool with Indemnity; 965 Multiple - Family Pool (May Include Prepayable Loans, with Indemnity); 966 Multiple Family Loan Pool with Closed Mortgages; 967 Homeowner Loan Pool; 970 Homeowner Loan Pool with Indemnity; 975 Homeowner Loan Pool with Indemnity; 980 Homeowner Loan Pool; 981 Homeowner Loan Pool - CORRA; 985 Homeowner Loan Pool; 986 Homeowner Loan Pool - CORRA; 987 Homeowner Loan Pool; 990 Social Housing Loan Pool. XFA: Page1.Sub1.DropDownList1 (stored with its label, e.g. '975: Homeowner Loan Pool with Indemnity').

parties.description: Names printed in the page 1 body. The addendum repeats the issuer name; the addendum header copy is available as addendum.issuerName.

issuerName.description: Name after 'Issued by' on page 1. XFA: Page1.Sub1.IssuedBy.

custodian.description: Name after 'securities will be held in custody by'. XFA: the rate-section field TextField4 (e.g. Page1.FixedRate.TextField4, Page1.VariableRate.Text885.TextField4, Page1.AdjustableRate.Text880.TextField4, Page1.WAC.TextField3).

mortgageInsurer.description: Mortgage insurer name(s) after '...mortgage loans insured by'. May contain multiple insurers. XFA: the rate-section field TextField3 (e.g. Page1.FixedRate.TextField3, Page1.VariableRate.Text885.TextField3, Page1.AdjustableRate.Text880.TextField3, Page1.WAC.TextField3).

mbs.description: Issue-level values printed in the page 1 header and repeated in the addendum header.

aggregatePrincipalAmount.description: Aggregate principal amount of the pool in Canadian dollars. Printed after 'Aggregate Principal Amount'. This should equal the total of the scheduled-maturity table and the RAM distributions. XFA: Page1.Sub1.TextField4.

poolNumber.description: Eight-digit pool number. The printed form may insert spaces (e.g. '96 503 183'); normalize to eight digits. XFA: Page1.Sub1.Sub2.PoolNo.

issueDate.description: ISSUE DATE on page 1. XFA: Page1.Sub1.Sub2.IssueDate.

settlementDate.description: SETTLEMENT DATE on page 1. XFA: Page1.Sub1.Sub2.TextField3.

firstPaymentDue.description: FIRST PAYMENT DUE on page 1. XFA: Page1.Sub1.Sub2.TextField4.

maturityDate.description: MATURITY DATE on page 1. XFA: Page1.Sub1.Sub2.TextField5.

finalPaymentDue.description: FINAL PAYMENT DUE on page 1. XFA: Page1.Sub1.Sub2.TextField6.

coupon.description: The text printed immediately before 'Mortgage-Backed Securities' on page 1. It is a plain rate for fixed-rate pools, or an index plus spread for variable/adjustable/WAC pools.

displayText.description: Exact coupon text without the trailing words 'Mortgage-Backed Securities', for example '3.47690%', 'CDOR -0.09200%', 'One-Month Daily Compounded CORRA +0.01000%', or 'WAC -0.50000%'. XFA: Page1.Sub1.TextField3.

kind.description: Normalized form of the coupon: fixed percentage, CDOR spread, CORRA spread, or WAC spread.

fixedRatePercent.description: The fixed annual coupon rate in percent. Required when kind is 'fixed'.

index.description: Index name for a spread-based coupon, for example 'CDOR', 'One-Month Daily Compounded CORRA', or 'WAC'. Required when kind is not 'fixed'.

spreadPercent.description: Spread over the index in percentage points. May be negative, for example -0.092. Required when kind is not 'fixed'.

addendum.description: Values on the 'ADDENDUM TO NHA MBS INFORMATION CIRCULAR' pages. The addendum repeats the issuer name, coupon, pool number and dates from page 1; those repeated header values are available under parties and mbs and are not duplicated here except for the optional issuerName and couponDisplayText properties.

issuerName.description: Issuer name printed under 'ISSUER' on the addendum. Should match parties.issuerName. XFA: Page2.TextField3 (issuer-name occurrence).

couponDisplayText.description: Coupon text printed under the issuer name on the addendum (for example '3.47690%' or 'CDOR -0.09200%'). Should match mbs.coupon.displayText.

totalNumberOfMortgageLoans.description: Total Number of Mortgage Loans. XFA: Page2.TextField3 (first captioned field).

weightedAverageInterestAdjustmentDate.description: Weighted Average Interest Adjustment Date. XFA: Page2.TextField3 (second captioned field).

weightedAverageMaturityDate.description: Weighted Average Maturity Date. XFA: Page2.TextField3 (field after the addendum issuer/coupon block).

scheduledMaturity.description: Table 'Scheduled Maturity of Mortgage Loans by Months Remaining to MBS Maturity'. For fixed-rate pools the index-spread and introductory columns are marked 'Not Applicable for Fixed Rate MBS' and may be omitted.

indexSpreadIndex.description: Index name inserted in the table heading 'Weighted-Average Mortgage Loan Index Spread (to ___)', for example 'Prime', 'CDOR' or 'CORRA'. Blank for fixed-rate pools. XFA: anonymous text field in the table heading.

total.description: The unlabelled total row at the bottom of the table.

remainingFaceValue.description: Remaining Face Value ($) for this maturity bucket.

weightedAverageMortgageRatePercent.description: Weighted-Average Mortgage Loan Rate ('WAC') (%) for this maturity bucket.

weightedAverageRemainingAmortizationMont.description: Weighted-Average Remaining Amortization ('RAM') in months. May be fractional, e.g. 242.502.

indexSpreadTotalPercent.description: Weighted-Average Mortgage Loan Index Spread, Total (%) column. May be negative.

indexSpreadFullTermPercent.description: Weighted-Average Mortgage Loan Index Spread, Full Term (%) column. May be negative.

indexSpreadIntroductoryPercent.description: Weighted-Average Mortgage Loan Index Spread, Introductory (%) column. May be negative.

sumOfMonthlyPaymentEquivalents.description: Sum of Monthly Payment Equivalents ($) for this maturity bucket.

insurerProfile.description: Table 'MORTGAGE LOAN POOL PROFILE BY INSURER'. The printed form has room for up to four rows; each row is one insurer.

name.description: Insurer name, e.g. 'Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation (CMHC)'.

dollarValue.description: Dollar value of loans insured by this insurer.

percentOfLoans.description: Percentage of loans insured by this insurer.

loanTypeProfile.description: Section 'DOLLAR PERCENTAGE PROFILE BY LOAN TYPE'. The three percentages should total 100.

ramDistribution.description: Section 'RAM DISTRIBUTION IN MONTHS'. The form prints two rows of six 'REMAINING FACE VALUE' amounts. The top row uses the RAM buckets 180-209, 210-239, 240-269, 270-299, 300-329, 330+ months; the bottom row uses the buckets 0-29, 30-59, 60-89, 90-119, 120-149, 150-180 months.

byRemainingAmortizationMonths.description: Top row of remaining face values: [180-209, 210-239, 240-269, 270-299, 300-329, 330+] months.

byRemainingTermMonths.description: Bottom row of remaining face values: [0-29, 30-59, 60-89, 90-119, 120-149, 150-180] months.

locationOfMortgageLoans.description: Table 'LOCATION OF MORTGAGE LOANS'. Each row has 'No. of Loans (%)' and 'Principal Amount (%)'. The final total row should total 100.0000 in each column.

total.description: Unlabelled total row at the bottom of the table (normally 100.0000 / 100.0000).

interestAdjustmentProfile.description: Table 'MORTGAGE LOAN POOL PROFILE BY INTEREST ADJUSTMENT DATE'. One or more printed interest-adjustment-date columns; each rate-band row contains the remaining face value for each date, a total, and a percentage of total. Older forms may print fewer than six columns.

interestAdjustmentDates.description: The printed interest-adjustment date column headings (for example Feb/2026 through Jul/2026), normalized to ISO 8601 dates. Older forms may print fewer than six columns.

rateBands.description: Rate-band rows, for example '3.76 - 4.00'. Empty rows may be omitted.

rateBand.description: Rate-band label in the first column, e.g. '3.76 - 4.00'.

remainingFaceValueByDate.description: Remaining face values for the printed interest adjustment dates, in the same order as interestAdjustmentDates.

percentOfTotal.description: % OF TOTAL for this rate band.

byDate.description: Totals for the printed interest adjustment dates.

percentOfTotal.description: Percentage in the '% OF TOTAL' column of the total row.

byDate.description: Percentage-of-total values for the printed interest adjustment dates.

percentOfTotal.description: Percentage in the '% OF TOTAL' column of this row (normally 0.0000).

byDate.description: Weighted-average coupon rate for each of the printed interest adjustment dates.

total.description: WAC value in the total column.

percentOfTotal.description: WAC value in the '% OF TOTAL' column (normally 0.0000).

prepaymentProvisions.description: Values entered on the page 4 prepayment-provisions pages. The heading and standard text vary with poolType. Sections A and B are present for every pool type except 966 and 990. Pools 970 and 975 also have the bona-fide-sale checkbox. Section A/B fields hold free-form text (often numbered paragraphs).

bonaFideSaleIndemnityExempt.description: Pools 970 and 975 only: 'Issuer to check this box if prepayments resulting from a bona-fide sale of the underlying property to a third party will, in all cases, not be subject to an indemnity.' XFA: Page4.Pl_970.CheckBox1 or Page4.Pl_975.CheckBox1.

sectionA.description: Text under section A. The heading depends on pool type: 'Loan Prepayment Provisions for Which a Penalty Is Not Chargeable to the Borrower' for most pools; 'Indemnity-Exempt Loan Prepayment Provisions (Exempt from the MBS Yield Maintenance Fee)' for 965; 'Indemnity-Exempt Loan Prepayment Provisions (Exempt from the Rate Differential Indemnity)' for 970/975. XFA: TextFieldA in the matching Page4.Pl_<poolType> subform.

sectionB.description: Text under section B. The heading depends on pool type: 'Loan Prepayment Provisions for Which a Penalty Is Chargeable to the Borrower' for most pools; 'Loan Prepayment Provisions to Which the MBS Yield Maintenance Fee Shall Apply' for 965; 'Loan Prepayment Provisions to Which the Rate Differential Indemnity Shall Apply' for 970/975. XFA: TextFieldB in the matching Page4.Pl_<poolType> subform.

otherDisclosures.description: Text under 'Other Disclosures for the Pool'. Present for every pool type. May be empty. XFA: TextField9 in the matching Page4.Pl_<poolType> subform.

amount.description: A monetary amount in Canadian dollars. Use a JSON number, not a formatted string; for example 13459779.76.

percent.description: A percentage expressed as a number in the range 0–100 (for example 3.4769, not 0.034769).

rate.description: An annual interest rate expressed as a percentage in the range 0–100.

spread.description: A spread over an index, expressed in percentage points. Negative values are allowed (for example -0.092 for 'CDOR -0.09200%').

date.description: An ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). The printed form uses long English dates such as 'October 1, 2026' or 'Feb/2026'; normalize before validation.

dateCountAmounts.description: Remaining face values for the printed interest adjustment dates.

dateCountPercents.description: Percentage values for the printed interest adjustment dates.

dateCountRates.description: Weighted-average coupon rates for the printed interest adjustment dates.
